caption:
Two days to go for #COP29! 🌍 @‌The Sustainable Energy Hub will be on the ground, identifying opportunities to catalyze energy finance, increase investment, and foster multi-sectoral partnerships to scale impact, and advance the energy-for-development pathway.

Join us at these 3 key events with our partners United Nations Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) , Alliance of Small Island States (AOSIS) and IBM

1. Financing a Sustainable Energy Future: Joining forces to catalyze private investment for accelerating a just transition
👉 Actionable strategies to catalyze private investment to accelerate a fair and inclusive energy transition.
📅 11 Nov | ⏰ 15:15 - 17:00 | 📍 @UNDESA Pavilion

2. Accelerating the Just Energy Transition in SIDS
👉 Opportunities for SIDS to leverage the just energy transition for resilience and economic growth.
📅 13 Nov | ⏰ 13:00 | 📍 UNDP Pavilion

3. Driving Clean Energy Progress with AI Solutions
👉 Exploring AI, data, and digital solutions to accelerate clean energy progress and support a just transition.
📅 15 Nov | ⏰ 11:00 - 12:00 | 📍 SDG7 Global South Pavilion

Be part of the #SustainableEnergyRevolution at #COP29—our collective agenda is most powerful and effective through collaboration. UNDP stands ready as a trusted partner, providing integrated solutions and leading efforts to help countries access, channel, and deliver financing for climate and development goals.

I look forward to working with global leaders and stakeholders to develop integrated, digitally optimized, and coordinated approaches for the sustainable energy revolution our world urgently needs.  🌎

#EnergyForDevelopment #SustainableEnergyRevolution⚡️ #EnergyTransition
